title: Analysis code for "A large-scale integrated optical phased array with digital beamforming"
description:
Signal-processing and figure-generation code for a 128-element silicon photonic optical phased array receiver with fully parallelized readout, in which beamforming is performed entirely in the digital domain on per-element amplitude and phase.

Includes the Python notebooks that generated Figures 3d–f and 4a–d, the original MATLAB implementation of the same pipeline, and the hardware-control script for the transimpedance-amplifier motherboard.

The measurement data these scripts consume is archived in a companion Zenodo record (see Related identifiers).
